reason: Fresh adversarial review after M1 found impossible package closure, missing M3 CLI/state ownership, writable legacy port evidence in M4/M5, and an incomplete M7 hard-cut selector. The operator explicitly authorized repair and re-freeze.

globalRules.activeTouch: Only activeTouchAllowlist paths may be changed by an implementation lane.
globalRules.readOnlyPortEvidence: Legacy port selectors are read-only behavioral evidence until the M7 absence-proven hard cut.
globalRules.generatedArtifacts: Clean-room release outputs are generated outside the source checkout and are never added to a source-edit allowlist.
globalRules.externalQualification: Missing signed artifacts, pinned RightKit AX, or real-client environments produce EXTERNAL_QUALIFICATION_BLOCKED and never fabricated PASS evidence. Repository-local M2 and M3 implementation may progress behind that typed boundary; M6 alone owns release qualification and no publish or Full-support claim may proceed while blocked.
globalRules.membrane: No amendment grants access to Membrane.

portableProfile.rule: The sole M2 portable skill is declarative, self-contained, and references only the installed MCP surface. legion_host::agent_plugins assembles generated entries from verified signed-release inputs into a clean-room external staging root. No legacy skills tree, executable, interpreter, symlink, or source-checkout path is copied.

M2.cliLease: Narrow M2 lease: accept --plugin-root on serve, validate the closed package root, and bind its release manifest to the loaded native application before MCP startup. Preserve every other M1 CLI route.
M2.progressionRule: Passing repository-local M2 implementation checks permits M3 implementation. External qualification remains blocked and is not an M2 completion prerequisite because M3 installation is required to produce the real-client evidence that M6 evaluates.

leases.cli: Append-only Setup grammar/dispatch and bare setup status integration; M1 Serve/MCP/status --config behavior remains owned by M1.
leases.host: M3 adds setup_registry and its directories-next native-platform resolver dependency, including the resulting Cargo.lock resolution, but may not edit M2 install, projection, uninstall, or verify modules.

retained.engine/crates/legion-decisions: Existing decision-compatibility domain; not canonical platform state.
retained.src/lib/decision_provider.py: Retained project/Architect workflow tooling; not shipped canonical Legion state.
retained.src/lib/decision_store.py: Retained project/Architect workflow tooling; not shipped canonical Legion state.

M4.activeTouchRule: Only current roadmap M4 allowlist paths under engine/ are active, plus the added Rust targets below.
M4.dependencyRule: Provider SDK interface freeze precedes Rules, Research, Review, and Audit. Report rendering may run concurrently with provider SDK. Audit follows Rules and provider SDK.

M5.activeTouchRule: Only current roadmap M5 allowlist paths under engine/ are active.
M5.interfaceBarrier: legion-provider-sdk including external_project_tool.rs is frozen before dependent M4 lanes execute.

M6.rule: M6 remains the sole owner of immutable signed-artifact, clean-package, pinned-AX, and two-real-client acceptance evidence.

M7.authorizationRule: Resolve the two immutable selectors to a sorted content-addressed 911-path allowlist only after M6 PASS and native absence proof; never use a mutable glob.
